children: KR1 plc, a blockchain infrastructure company listed on the London Stock Exchange, has launched its own Ethereum validator, operated by P2P.org through Lido V3 stVaults. According to Odaily, KR1 plans to stake up to 6,000 ETH, beginning with 10 validators; the rollout schedule depends on the Ethereum validator entry queue. KR1 retains control over withdrawals, validator fee arrangements and vault permissions, and may mint stETH to access liquidity. Lido said stVaults allow stakers to select validators and retain control while maintaining liquidity through stETH. Lido also said the stVaults smart contracts have been audited by Certora, MixBytes, Consensys Diligence, Ackee Blockchain and Sigma Prime, and are covered by a bug bounty of up to $2 million.

title: London Stock Exchange-Listed KR1 Launches Ethereum Validator, Plans to Stake Up to 6,000 ETH
